rubric.formula: score = round(100 * sum(weight * credit) / sum(weight)); uncertain evidence excluded and flagged
rubric.omissions_formula: score = max(0, 100 - sum(penalty)); penalty: lost 8*w, changed 4*w, added 3*w, preserved 0
rubric.not_applicable: feature-presence dimensions (emotion, imagery, voice, cultural, wordplay) with no evidence
rubric.not_evaluated: semantic, tone, omissions with no recorded evidence; never shown as 0
